basis_label: Dimensions and anatomical or structural basis
author: Universe Scales
note: Original Architeuthis anatomical illustration at a 13 m posterior-tip-to-feeding-club span, following the Smithsonian and Natural History Museum female maximum-length estimate. Eight shorter arms, two long feeding tentacles with distal clubs, terminal fins and large lateral eyes follow the Smithsonian anatomical diagram. All intermediate proportions, arm poses, sucker sizes/counts, surface colors and fin contours are authored; this is not a specimen reconstruction, scan, or claim that all squid reach this size. Feeding tentacles are extended to make the total-length definition visible. There are no colossal-squid hooks.

processing.details: All other shapes, placements, surface pattern and colors are authored illustration controls, not measured data.
